Insurance Advisory

Understand your life insurance options before you decide

I’m a Bajaj Life Insurance advisor. I help interested customers understand relevant life insurance products and enquire about policy options. Request a conversation and ask your questions.

Introduction

Insurance advisory, in plain language

Insurance can feel complicated. As an advisor for Bajaj Life Insurance, my role is to help you understand the products that may be relevant to you, answer your questions and explain how to enquire about policy options.

I won’t pressure you or promise returns. The goal is that you understand what you’re looking at before making a decision.

Policy suitability depends on individual needs and the applicable policy terms. Actual benefits, exclusions, charges and conditions are governed by the official policy documents.

Why it matters

Why life insurance planning matters

A general explanation of protection and financial planning.

Protection for people who depend on you

Life insurance is generally about financial protection for the people who rely on your income, according to the terms of the policy you choose.

Part of wider financial planning

It’s one piece of planning alongside savings, expenses and goals. What suits one person may not suit another.

Understanding before deciding

Reading the official terms, and asking questions about anything unclear, helps you make a decision that fits your needs.

How I can help

What an advisory conversation covers

  • Explaining relevant life insurance products in simple terms
  • Answering your questions about policy options
  • Pointing you to the official policy documents to read
  • Helping you enquire about the next steps

FAQ

Frequently asked questions

What is life insurance?

In general terms, life insurance is a contract in which an insurer agrees to pay a defined amount to a nominated person or persons under the conditions set out in the policy. What a specific policy offers depends entirely on its official terms.

Are returns guaranteed?

Nothing is promised here. Whether a particular product has guaranteed benefits depends on that product’s official terms, which should be read in full before you decide.

Can you tell me which policy is best for me?

Suitability depends on your individual needs and the applicable policy terms. An advisor can help you understand relevant products and the questions to ask, but the official policy documents are what govern the policy.

What will you ask me for in the enquiry form?

Only basic contact details, your preferred contact method and a suitable time. Please don’t share sensitive financial or personal details through this form, such as Aadhaar, PAN, bank or card numbers or health records.

Are the benefits, premiums and eligibility listed here?

No. This page is general information and deliberately does not list benefits, premiums or eligibility rules. Those are set out in the official documents for each product.

Does this page replace the policy document?

No. Actual benefits, exclusions, charges and conditions are governed by the official policy documents.
